0022600088.text: The Raptors open their 2026-27 season at home against the Chicago Bulls, who have also not played a game yet this season, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives Toronto a 75% chance to win. Toronto is without Brandon Ingram, who is out after Achilles surgery, and Nate Bittle is day-to-day with a foot injury and a game-time decision. Chicago's Isaac Okoro (undisclosed), Nic Claxton (hamstring), Tobe Awaka (knee) and Zach Collins (toe, after surgery) are all day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions, and the Raptors won the 2025-26 season series 3-0, including a 139-109 win in Chicago on March 18, 2026.
